// Raw-os corpus for the path-field taint scan (TestPathTaintRawOS): every way a
// declared field reaches a package-level os function without a Contained
// trips, and the finding names the field it came from.
package rawos

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/changes"
	"github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/project"
	"github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/state"
	"github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/survivor"
)

// A changes.TaskRecord.Files element read straight off disk.
func readTaskFile(rec changes.TaskRecord) {
	for _, f := range rec.Files {
		_, _ = os.ReadFile(f) // WANT pathtaint
	}
}

// project.Env.Files is declared NotConsumed: stat-ing it is opening it.
func statEnvFile(env *project.Env) {
	if len(env.Files) > 0 {
		_, _ = os.Stat(env.Files[0]) // WANT pathtaint
	}
}

// Joined onto a root: the join keeps the field.
func openJoined(root string, rec *changes.TaskRecord) {
	fh, err := os.Open(filepath.Join(root, rec.Files[0])) // WANT pathtaint
	if err == nil {
		_ = fh.Close()
	}
}

// os.Lstat was absent from the old residual scan's verb list.
func lstatDoc(rp changes.RedProof) {
	_, _ = os.Lstat(rp.Doc) // WANT pathtaint
}

// Copied into a struct in one function, removed in another.
type pending struct{ target string }

func queueRemoval(a survivor.Acceptance) *pending {
	return &pending{target: a.File}
}

func removeCopied(p *pending) {
	_ = os.Remove(p.target) // WANT pathtaint
}

// A ledger row is traced too: state.State.Version is filed as not a path, so a
// file named by it trips, and the finding names the row.
func readVersionAsFile(s *state.State) {
	_, _ = os.ReadFile(s.Version + ".toml") // WANT pathtaint
}

// The environment functions take names and values, not paths.
func exportDoc(rp *changes.RedProof) {
	_ = os.Setenv("DROSS_DOC", rp.Doc)
}

// Two fields read on one line: the finding names the one that reached the
// open, not its neighbour.
func readOneOfTwo(rp *changes.RedProof, s *state.State) {
	doc, ver := rp.Doc, s.Version
	_ = os.Setenv("DROSS_VERSION", ver)
	_, _ = os.ReadFile(doc) // WANT pathtaint
}
